narrative_map.working: Local groups exchange via shared memory; only unknown codes evolve; observed-only reference gates candidate; world content is reused.
narrative_map.technical: Source method Secs 3.2-3.5 retain detailed operators, thresholds, physical constraints and training.

operands.completion: Observed/current latents, masks/confidence, type, canonical/reference-world coordinates, log summaries, flow time.
operands.projection: Restore observed, clear free at EVERY integration step; unknown-only velocity.
operands.decoding: Per-query typed decoders; free Gaussian opacity zero; human binding retained; sky separate head.
operands.validation: Candidate and observed-only reference rendered at original camera/actor states and compared with recorded views.
operands.reuse: Same fixed world with changed camera/vehicle/human states; no resampling.
